scope: Independent black-box validation of the exact packaged CLI; no working-source imports
required_scenarios: doctor profile passes and foundation integrity verified
full catalog counts and original status counts preserved
executable-only query includes only pinned capabilities and declared cases
catalog query and collection filters work
metadata-only and blocked records cannot run
Python baseline actually runs and matches frozen evidence
C# correct candidate runs and is accepted
C# regression diagnostic passes while candidate acceptance remains false
verify validates saved evidence without creating a run
fresh verify creates a distinct attempt with equivalent deterministic outcome
simulated interrupted request has explicit incomplete state and resume creates one linked fresh attempt
repeat resume reuses existing child without duplicate execution
report links evidence and preserves fixture/scientific claim boundaries
malformed run evidence produces an integrity-fail entry rather than aborting report
HTML report escapes hostile text in an error field
invalid case, component and timeout are rejected
state paths within the package and original delivery roots are rejected before write
noninteractive default menu exits without hanging
exact package files remain unchanged throughout acceptance
negative_test_policy: Fault injection changes only separately created test run state, never package bytes or original deliveries. Candidate scientific results are not relabeled by diagnostic success.
pass_rule: Every required scenario passes against the same immutable candidate; metadata and source documents do not substitute for execution evidence.
